title: Not as advertised AND inferior product
text: Not as advertised AND inferior product. I bought this table for my garage to place my Excalibur dehydrator (also bought from Amazon) on it along with some other lightweight items. The dehydrater weighs only 22 lbs. I have it placed on the center of the table and the dips sags/dips where it sits. The info on the table says it has a 260 lb weight capacity so I have no idea why 22 lbs would cause the sagging other than it is bad quality material pushed off by amazon as something its not clearly you couldn't put anywhere near the supposed weight on it. i would like to send it back but no longer have the box. i would have sooner but just noticed this defect a couple weeks after i received it. I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS TABLE EXCEPT MAYBE IF YOU'RE JUST EATING LIGHTWEIGHT STUFF ON IT. BOILED SEAFOOD OR SAY A WATERMELON WOULD BE TOO HEAVY. RIDICULOUS.
